Tasks: add, edit, complete, delete, search, and filter tasks. Inspections: create, edit, complete, and filter equipment inspection records. Settings: choose system/light/dark appearance, blue/green/purple colors, and system/Chinese/English language; set a video cache limit, edit the local nickname, and view sign-in status. The examples tab demonstrates Feed, images, files, and video; Feed uses local sample data when no service is configured. You can share a feedback draft through Android\'s share sheet. This project has no dedicated support address.

Current data handling summary: tasks and completion state are stored in local Room; nickname, theme, and cache limit are stored in local DataStore. The password is used for a request to a configured authentication service and is not persisted by this project; session tokens are encrypted with Android Keystore. Configured Feed, image, file, and video URLs make network requests; downloads and caches are kept in app-private storage. Crash, page/network performance, and runtime metrics are sent to a remote endpoint only when an OTLP endpoint is configured and APM is enabled. No remote telemetry is sent without that configuration. This summary is not a formal privacy policy. Before release, document actual services and SDKs, purposes, retention, deletion, and contact details.
